items.name: yorha-provider
items.title: YorhaProvider
items.description: Provider and hooks for theme, motion, density and sound preference, plus Base UI direction (ltr/rtl) and CSP nonce. Writes data-theme, data-motion and data-density on <html>.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project. Wrap your app in <YorhaProvider>; useMotion persists the choice in localStorage key yorha:motion. direction sets the Base UI reading direction (default ltr); nonce is applied to inline styles Base UI emits.
